desc: A menu of Indian cuisine in a restaurant with family-friendly ambience & rural motifs.
addr: 140, Ground, Raheja Arcade, 139, Ganapathi Temple Rd, near The Forum (Nexus) Mall, 7th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: I recently had dinner at Gramin in Koramangala, and the food was definitely the highlight of the evening. We started with the Rajasthani Bhindi and Crispy Corn—both were excellent and set a high bar for the rest of the meal. …

Not worth the hype .. The mix veg soup set the tone what came next .. It was bland , tasteless n worth forgetting. When asked was informed that it's made without artificial flavors (n tasteless too! ) To it's credit Butter naan was soft but had paneer butter masala which didnt have any butter .. Overall an average fare
